headline: CLE @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.84 at DET 3.53, with a projected total of 8.37. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.38 runs while DET moved -0.12, changing the projected margin by +0.50 runs. NRFI probability dropped -11.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Framber Valdez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Travis Bazzana, Brayan Rocchio, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Rhys Hoskins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
